title: Libre 2 Connection issues
body:
Hi all,

I'm new to this community so, be patient if I'm missing some information in my inquiry due to my lack of experience. 
I have been experiencing some issues with lost con/nection of my Libre 2 sensor since last 22th of September. I've already tried 3 different sensors, as I removed the first one thinking that the problem was on a malfunctioning sensor (I returned it to Abbot and they sent me a new one without many questions). 
I'm using a Xiami Poco X6 Pro, with Libre 2. I usually use the Librelink and Xdrip+ (with OOP2) app at the same time (i haven't had any issues with that either the previous 10 months). Xdrip version is the latest version (as I've updated it to check if that was the issue) of October 4th, and OOP2 version is also the latest one of 21/09/25. 
Since that date, Libre 2 sensor has been disconnecting continously, loosing connection all the time. This issue has been the same with all of the sensors, so I'm trying to understand if something went wrong with my Bluetooth connection or maybe that's indeed a bad badge of sensors.
I attach some logs from Xdrip. Please feel free to request more from me if needed.

![WhatsApp Image 2025-10-06 at 07 27 01](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f66d88c5-5acf-41a4-85ec-3731aee64fe8)
![WhatsApp Image 2025-10-06 at 07 26 26](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e603eb0-4a69-4ba9-a39f-b30221fcdc4b)
![WhatsApp Image 2025-10-06 at 07 16 25](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a9575c68-9854-47bc-b6fc-e86fc3465356)
![WhatsApp Image 2025-10-06 at 07 15 58](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ae3b8d2b-d73f-46ba-8c64-ef6e2f255c8f)

I would really appreciate your help with this issue as I'm loosing my mind with it due to the lost of sleeping hours.

Thanks in advanced.

_Originally posted by @tatxobat in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/4151#discussioncomment-14601316_
